column3: śaṭhe dhūrtte kṛtaghne ca mandabuddhau na dīyate ||
brāhmaṇāya dhanurdeyaṁ khaḍgaṁ vai kṣatriyāya ca |
dhanuścakraṁ tu kuntaṁ ca khaḍgaṁ ca churikāṁ gadām |
dvābhyāṁ caiva bhavedyoddhā ekena gaṇako bhavet ||
janmasthe ca tṛtīye ca ṣaṣṭhe vai saptame tathā |
tṛtīyā pañcamī caiva saptamī navamī tathā |
trayodaśī dvādaśī ca tithayaśca śubhā matāḥ ||
aṅganyāsas tataḥ kāryaḥ śivoktaḥ siddhim icchatā |
pūrvavedhaiḥ kṛtāḥ puṁsā śarāḥ syuḥ sarvasādhakāḥ ||
paścime dhanadhānyaṁ ca sarvaṁ caivottare bhavet ||
varaṁ prāṇādhiko dhanvī natu prāṇādhikaṁ dhanuḥ |
dhanuṣā pīḍyamānastu dhanvī lakṣyaṁ na paśyati ||
devānāmuttamaṁ cāpaṁ tato nyūnaṁ ca mānavam ||
tad vijñeyaṁ dhanur divyaṁ śaṅkareṇa dhṛtaṁ purā ||
triparvaṁ pañcaparvaṁ ca saptaparvaṁ ca kīrtitam |
catuḥparvaṁ ca ṣaṭparvam aṣṭaparvaṁ ca varjayet |
galagranthi talagranthi na kartavyaṁ sadā budhaiḥ ||
jñātidhṛṣṭaṁ tu sodvegaṁ kalaho bāndhavaiḥ saha ||
bāhye lakṣyaṁ na labhyeta tathaivābhyantare.pi ca ||
hīne tu saṁdhite bāṇe saṁgrāme bhaṅgakārakam |
ākrānte tu punarlakṣye lakṣyaṁ na prāpyate dṛḍham ||
śārṅgaṁ tu vai dhanurdivyaṁ tadviṣṇoḥ paramāyudham |
na svarge na ca pātāle na bhūmau kasyacitkare |
pauruṣeyaṁ tu yat kāryaṁ bahuyatnena yojitam |
prāyo jñeyaṁ dhanuḥ śārṅgaṁ gajārohasya sādhanam |
rathināṁ ca padātīnāṁ vāṁśaṁ cāpaṁ prakīrtitam ||
vartitaḥ syād guṇaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvakāryasaho yudhi |
tasyāstatra guṇaḥ kāryaḥ pavitraḥ sthāvaro dṛḍhaḥ ||
tadvṛttaṁ triguṇaṁ kāryaṁ pramāṇo.yaṁ guṇasya ca ||
sūcīmukhaṁ ca bhallaṁ ca vatsadantaṁ suvallabham ||
bhallena hṛdayaṁ vedhyaṁ dvibhallena tathaiva ca |
lohaṁ ca kākatuṇḍena lakṣyaṁ gopucchakena ca ||
pippalī saindhavaṁ kuṣṭhaṁ gomūtreṇa ca peṣayet |
tato nirvāpitaṁ lohaṁ tatra vedhe viśiṣyate ||
yujyante dūrapāteṣu durge yuddheṣu te matāḥ ||
sṛṣṭyaḥ pañca samākhyātā vyāyāḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ ||
ālīḍhe tu prakartakaṁ tathā caivānu kuñcitam ||
pādau na vistarau kāryau samau hastapramāṇataḥ ||
same pāte samau pādau niṣkampaṁ ca susaṁgatau ||
asame ca purobhāge hastamātreṇa taṁ viduḥ |
savyaṁ jānu nataṁ bhūmau dakṣiṇaṁ na ca kuñcitam |
agrato yatra dātavyaṁ taṁ vidyād garuḍaṁ kramam ||
patākā sā ca vijñeyā nālikā dūramokṣaṇe ||
matsarī sā ca vijñeyā sūkṣmalakṣyasya bhedane ||
aṅguṣṭhāgre tu tarjanyā mukhaṁ yatra niveśitam |
kākatuṇḍī ca sā jñeyā sthūlalakṣyeṣu yojitā ||
sandhānaṁ trividhaṁ proktam adha ūrdhvaṁ samaṁ yadā yojayet triprakāraṁ hi kāryeṣvapi yathākramam ||
kaiśikaḥ śaramūle ca śaraśūṅge ca sāttvikaḥ |
aṁsake skandhanāmā ca vyāyāḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ |
dṛḍhabhede ca dūre ca skandhanāmānam uddiśet ||
lakṣyaṁ caturvidhaṁ jñeyaṁ sthiraṁ caiva calaṁ tathā |
ātmānaṁ susthiraṁ kṛtvā lakṣyaṁ caiva sthiraṁ budhaḥ |
vedhayet triprakāraṁ tu sthiravedhī sa ucyate ||
calavedhīti sa prokta ācāryeṇa śivena vai ||
dhanvī tu calate yatra sthiralakṣye samāhitaḥ |
ubhāveva calau yatra lakṣyaṁ vāpi dhanurdharaḥ |
tad vijñeyaṁ dvayacalaṁ śrameṇaiva hi sādhakaḥ ||
tasmād gurusamīpe tu śramaḥ kāryo vijānatā ||
prathamaṁ vāmahastena yaḥ śramaṁ kurute naraḥ |
vāmenaiva śramaṁ kuryāt susiddhe dakṣiṇe kare |
viśākhasthānake caiva tathā vyāye ca kaiśike ||
saṁgrāmeṇa vinā kāryaṁ na lakṣyaṁ dakṣiṇāmukham ||
catuḥśataiśca kāṇḍānāṁ yo hi lakṣyaṁ samabhyaset |
sūryodaye cāstakāle sa jyeṣṭho dhanvināṁ bhavet ||
yaḥ pādavedhī lakṣyasya sa kaniṣṭhatamo bhavet ||
ataḥ paraṁ pravakṣyāmi śarāṇāṁ lakṣaṇaṁ śubham |
ādravaṁ yad viśīrṇaṁ ca varjayed īdṛśaṁ śaram |
dvau hastau muṣṭihīnau ca dairghye sthaulye kaniṣṭhikāḥ ||
gṛdhrāṇāṁ ca kuraṅgānāṁ pakṣā eteṣu śobhanāḥ ||
yojyā dṛḍhāścatuḥsaṁkhyāḥ saṁnaddhāḥ snāyuḥ śarāśca trividhā jñeyāḥ strīpuṁsakanapuṁsakāḥ ||
aṣṭamī ca tathāmā ca varjanīyā caturdaśī |
akālagarjito devo durdinaṁ vā yadā bhavet |
śramaṁ ca kurvato yatra bhujaṅgo yadi dṛśyate |
truṭyate vā guṇo yatra prathame bāṇamokṣaṇe |
śramaṁ tatra na kurvīta śastre matimatāṁ varaḥ ||
sthānakaṁ tu tataḥ kuryād bāṇopari karaṁ nyaset ||
ādānaṁ tu tataḥ kṛtvā sandhānaṁ tu tataḥ param ||
ṣaṇmāsāt sidhyate muṣṭiḥ śarāḥ saṁvatsareṇa tu |
rājāno dṛṣṭim icchanti lakṣyam icchanti cetare ||
pūrvāparau samau kāryau samāṁsau niścalau karau ||
sa ca lakṣyeṣu kartavyo lakṣye yodho jitaśramaḥ ||
ādānaṁ caiva tūṇīrāt sandhānaṁ karṣaṇaṁ tathā |
kṣepaṇaṁ ca tvarāyukto bāṇasya kurute tu yaḥ ||
skandhavyāyena vajrasya muṣṭyā puṁmārgaṇe na ca |
karkaśe na tu cāpena yat kṛṣyeddhīnamuṣṭinā |
ṛjutve na vinā yāti kṣepyamānastu sāyakaḥ ||
pārśve tu dakṣiṇaṁ yāti sāyakasya na saṁśayaḥ ||
samukto mārgaṇo lakṣyādūrdhvaṁ yāti na saṁśayaḥ ||
ākarṣaṇe caiva bāṇasya cāpe muṣṭiradho bhavet |
tadānīm ujjhito bāṇo lakṣyānna calati dhruvam ||
naro nāgāśca kāyeṣu na sa tiṣṭhati mārgaṇaḥ ||
yasya tṛṇasamā bāṇā yat saṁdhānasamaṁ dhanuḥ |
yasya prāṇasamā maurvī sa dhanvī dhanvināṁ varaḥ ||
yo bhinatti na tasyeṣur vajriṇāpi ca bādhyate ||
tasya bāṇo gajendrasya kāyaṁ nirbhidya gacchati ||
bhrāmyajjale ghaṭo vedhyaḥ cakre mṛtpiṇḍakaṁ tathā |
mṛtpiṇḍaṁ ca ghaṭaṁ caiva vidhyetsūcīmukhena vai ||
bindukaṁ caiva yugakaṁ yo vetti sa jayī bhavet ||
saṁmukhaṁ bāṇam āyāntaṁ tiryagbāṇaṁ na saṁcaret |
prāptaṁ śareṇa yaśchindyād bāṇacchedī sa ucyate ||
hastena bhrāmyamāṇaṁ ca yo hanti sa dhanurdharaḥ ||
pañcaviddhaṁ nyasecchastraṁ śuddhaṁ hāstikaṁ bindukaṁ yastu citrabhedī sa ucyate ||
lakṣyaviddhaṁ kāṣṭhaṁ kṣipraṁ dūramūrūrddha vapuḥ svayaṁ prāptaśaraṁ pṛṣṭhe ūrdhvapucchamukhena hi ||
yaḥ chindyāttaṁ kṣurapreṇa kāṣṭhavedhī sa yāyate ||
yatropalabhyate śabdaḥ samyak taṁ tatra cintayet |
tato bāṇena taṁ hanyāt tadavadhānena dhīmatā |
etacca duṣkaraṁ karma bhāgyāt kasyāpi sidhyati ||
atha śramavidhiṁ kuryād yāvat siddhiḥ prajāyate |
śrame siddhe ca varṣāsu naiva grāhyaṁ dhanuṣkare ||
māsadvayaṁ śramaṁ kuryāt prati varṣaṁ śaradṛtau ||
jāte cāśvayuje māsi navamī devatā dine |
pūjayed īśvarīṁ caṇḍīṁ guruṁ śāstrāṇi vājigaḥ ||
śūlena pāhi no devi pāhi khaḍgeṇa cāmbike |
prācyāṁ rakṣa pratīcyāṁ ca caṇḍike rakṣa dakṣiṇe |
saumyāni yāni rūpāṇi trailokye vicaranti te |
yāni cātyarthaghorāṇi tai rakṣāsmān tathā bhuvam ||
prayogaṁ copasaṁhāraṁ yo vetti sa dhanurdharaḥ |
śūrasyāpi raṇe puṁso darpaṁ harati tatkṣaṇāt ||
viṣṇukrāntā ca sarvāsāṁ jaṭā grāhyā raverdine |
baddhvā bhuje vilepād vā kāye sarvāstrāpavārakaḥ ||
dehaṁ sphuṭati notīkṣṇaṁ maṇḍalāgre raṇe nṝṇām ||
śubhrāyāḥ śarapuṅkhāyā jaṭā nīlī jaṭā tathā |
bhuje śirasi vaktre vā sthitā śastranivārikā ||
pūrvaṁ sārathimāropya rathe sajjet tataḥ svayam ||

column5: pāṇḍavagītāyām |lābhas teṣāṁ jayas teṣāṁ kutas teṣāṁ parābhavaḥ |yeṣām indīvaraśyāmo hṛdayasthajanārdanaḥ ||

column3: hayāṇāṁ ca parimāṇam etad eva suniścitam |
jñeyaṁ lakṣaṁ padātīnāṁ sahasrāṇi tathā nava ||
agre rathā gajāḥ pṛṣṭhe tatpṛṣṭhe ca padātayaḥ |
ardhacandraṁ ca candraṁ ca śakaṭaṁ makaraṁ tathā |
kamalaṁ śreṇikāṁ gulmaṁ vyūhān evaṁ prakalpate ||
yasmin raṇe yaḥ puruṣaḥ pradhānaḥ sa sarvayatnena hi tasmin vinaṣṭe kila sarvabhūte sarve.pi yodhāstvabalā |
api ca svaśriyai sainyaṁ vṛtheyaṁ muṇḍamaṇḍalī ||
api pañcaśatāḥ śūrā gṛhṇanti mahatīṁ camūm |

column5: dvāv imau puruṣau loke sūryamaṇḍalabhedinau |parivrāḍ yogayuktaś ca raṇe cābhimukho hataḥ ||

column3: yatra yatra hataḥ śūraḥ śatrubhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ |
akṣayaṁ labhate lokaṁ yadi dainyaṁ na bhāṣate ||
column5: yatra yatra hataḥ śūraḥ śatrubhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ |akṣayāṁl labhate lokān yadi klībaṁ na bhāṣate ||

column3: palāyamāṇaṁ śaraṇaṁ gataṁ caiva na hiṁsayet ||
alpāyāṁ vā mahatyāṁ vā senāyāmiti niścayaḥ |
anvevaṁ vāyavo yānti dakṣiṇe ca vayāṁsi ca |
anusarve.pi piśitā yasya yānti raṇe jayaḥ ||
